What happens when an elite, materialist Memory Champion gets secretly recruited into an underground remote viewing project?   In this episode, 6x US Memory Champion, Nelson Dellis joins me to reveal the bizarre story of how he was hired by a trading firm to remote view  market. Nelson also went through the Monroe Institute’s Gateway experience retreat where he attempted out-of-body experiments to read a hidden code. We also explore how ancient memory palace techniques may intersect with theories of non-local consciousness.
